parameters.name: AppEntryRule
parameters.description:
The route configuration of the gateway.

>  This parameter is required if the gateway entry of the lane group is Java.

parameters.name: CanaryModel
parameters.description:
Full-link Grayscale Mode:

*   0: The request is routed based on the content of the request.
*   1: routing based on percentages

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description:
Lane Status

*   true: enabled
*   false: disabled

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the lane group to which the lane belongs.

parameters.name: MseGatewayEntryRule
parameters.description:
The route configuration of the MSE gateway.

>  If the **EntryAppType** is set to **apig** or **mse-gw**, it is required.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sae create-or-update-swimming-lane --lane-id 13857 --lane-name test --lane-tag g1 --group-id 1 --namespace-id cn-beijing:test --canary-model 0 --enable true --app-entry-rule '{"ConditionJoiner":"AND","Percentage":50,"PercentageByPath":{"key":"example-string"},"IndependentPercentageEnable":true,"Paths":["/A"],"Conditions":[{"Condition":"==","Type":"Header","Value":"g1","Name":"t"}]}' --mse-gateway-entry-rule '{"ConditionJoiner":"AND","RouteIds":[78830],"Percentage":100,"IndependentPercentageEnable":true,"PercentageByRoute":{"key":"example-string"},"Conditions":[{"Condition":"==","Type":"header","Value":"g1","Name":"test"}]}' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sae POST /pop/v1/cas/gray/createOrUpdateSwimmingLane --region cn-hangzhou --LaneTag g1 --AppEntryRule '{"ConditionJoiner":"AND","Percentage":50,"PercentageByPath":{"key":"example-string"},"IndependentPercentageEnable":true,"Paths":["/A"],"Conditions":[{"Condition":"==","Type":"Header","Value":"g1","Name":"t"}]}' --LaneName test --Enable true --NamespaceId 'cn-beijing:test' --CanaryModel 0 --LaneId 13857 --GroupId 1 --MseGatewayEntryRule '{"ConditionJoiner":"AND","RouteIds":[78830],"Percentage":100,"IndependentPercentageEnable":true,"PercentageByRoute":{"key":"example-string"},"Conditions":[{"Condition":"==","Type":"header","Value":"g1","Name":"test"}]}' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
